An die passende Session – oder der Walki: To the matching session – or the Walkie answers itself
Andere Programme spielen so lange mit di: Other apps keep playing at this share of their volume meanwhile and return to their previous volume afterwards. 100 = don’t lower.

Claude-Sessions oder das Terminal des ge: Claude sessions or the selected agent’s terminal
Danach entscheidest du nur noch am Rechn: After that you can only decide at the computer.
Die Figur sagt laut, was in deinen Sessi: The figure says out loud what is happening in your sessions.
Ein schnelles Codex-Modell, z. B. gpt-6-: A fast Codex model, e.g. gpt-6-luna.
Endet eine Session mit einer Frage, lies: When a session ends with a question, the figure reads it aloud and listens. Your answer goes to exactly that session.
Entscheidet, wohin Gesagtes geht, verste: Decides where what you say goes, understands answers and prepares texts for reading aloud. Automatic: the primary agent’s model; if it fails (e.g. usage limit), another installed agent.
Fenster nach vorne holen, wenn eine Sess: Bring window to front when a session asks
Funktioniert immer, auch ohne Kopfhörert: Always works, even without headset buttons. Empty = off. Written like <ctrl>+<alt>+<space> or <ctrl>+<shift>+b.
Fällt nach dem Loslassen auf Fenster ode: Falls onto windows or the floor when released, sits on window edges, climbs up screen edges (if the figure can, e.g. Shimejis).
Für Fragen und Recherche ohne passende S: For questions and research without a matching session (with web search).
Für Freigaben/Rückfragen wird immer Whis: Whisper is always used for approvals/questions.
Größer = genauer, aber langsamer. Wird b: Larger = more accurate but slower. Downloaded on first start.
Hier starten neue Sessions ohne genannte: New sessions without a named project start here. Empty = a dedicated Walkie folder (Claude asks for permission there only once).
Holt das Terminal der fragenden Session: Brings the asking session’s terminal to the foreground. “Show me” always works.
In welcher Sprache du sprichst. Automati: The language you speak. Automatic: Whisper detects it itself (a bit slower, less reliable for short sentences).
Ins Panel-Terminal über der Figur (brauc: To the panel terminal above the figure (needs kitty and the panel)
Jede Antwort deiner Sessions vorlesen –: Read every answer of your sessions aloud – also to typed messages. Off: only short announcements when something is done.
Kommt nur zum Zug, wenn du ihn ausdrückl: Only used when you address it explicitly (e.g. “ask Codex …”): opens a new session for it. The companion can only read aloud and keep talking to Claude sessions afterwards.
Kurze Hin-und-her-Runden werden nicht an: Short back-and-forth turns are not announced.
Lange Antworten in einem Satz (kostet ei: Long answers in one sentence (costs a few hundred tokens).
